remarks: Welcome to this charming 2-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom home located in the highly sought-after complex in Darien. This property features a spacious living room and dining area with soaring ceilings and abundant natural light, creating a bright and airy atmosphere. The eat-in kitchen boasts a cozy window bench, perfect for enjoying your morning coffee. The partially finished lower level offers flexible space ideal for a home office or playroom. Additional amenities include an attached garage and access to a community pool. Enjoy the convenience of walking to nearby shopping, making this a perfect blend of comfort and convenience.
